reasoning: The question asks whether CAD/USD will increase from Oct 11 to Oct 18, 2026. The FRED series measures Canadian dollars per US dollar, so an 'increase' means more CAD needed per USD (USD strengthening/CAD weakening). Recent data shows volatility around 1.42-1.43 CAD/USD. The loonie has been recovering from 18-month lows due to oil price support and narrowing yield spreads, but faces headwinds from elevated US yields and potential Fed rate hikes. Short-term currency movements are essentially unpredictable over a one-week horizon. Given the mixed signals and inherent randomness, I estimate roughly 50% probability.
